_: tools/build_images.py: where a photograph's subject sits, as a fraction of its height (0 top, 1 bottom), for the photos a card must crop. A card shows a photo at its own shape up to 300 px tall, so only square and portrait photos lose anything, and they lose it around this point rather than around the middle. Unlisted photos crop around 0.5. Read by eye, 2026-10-01, after the owner: 'if it's Cat… the cat shouldn't be cropped from the head up'.
